blocks.text: Romance in the ‘Bridgerton’ universe is far from over. Netflix recently announced a limited spin-off series about the love story of young Violet Bridgerton and her future husband, Edmund, giving fans another romance to look forward to. From fake courtships to forbidden love, the Regency franchise has made familiar romance tropes feel irresistible again. Adapted from Julia Quinn’s eight-book series, ‘Bridgerton’ follows the siblings’ journey to love. Here are nine romantic tropes that make the ‘Bridgerton’ universe irresistibly swoon-worthy.
